resources.string: DNS servers used inside the WARP tunnel and during its connection setup. Enter one or more IPv4/IPv6 addresses; automatic uses Cloudflare DNS.
DNS IP addresses separated by commas, e.g. 1.1.1.1, 2606:4700:4700::1111

These IP addresses are used by WARP for DNS lookups while the tunnel is active. Separate multiple addresses with commas. Leave empty to use Cloudflare DNS. DNS requests to custom servers are not encrypted unless the resolver itself provides encryption.
